qualifier: restraint of growth and developmental mesenchymal apoptosis
name: Negative regulation of kidney growth and developmental apoptosis
rationale: All members restrain metanephric kidney development, size, proliferation or developmental (mesenchymal) apoptosis, whereas confusables cover duct/ureter formation, nephron differentiation or glomerulus promotion rather than negative growth and anti-apoptotic control.

name: MET receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Every member is MET (HGF receptor) activation, effector coupling (PI3K, RAS, STAT3, PTPN11, RAP1/RAC1, PTK2, TNS), recycling or drug inhibition, distinguishing it from integrin/adhesion and PTK6/other RTK confusables.

qualifier: with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibitory checkpoints
name: TCR and BCR signaling with costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members are proximal TCR and BCR signaling plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 inhibitory tuning, covering both T and B cell receptors unlike the B cell development or T cell activation/differentiation confusables.

name: Presynaptic modulation and AMPA/kainate glutamatergic transmission
rationale: Members cover presynaptic regulation of glutamate/GABA release, G protein modulation of channels, short-term plasticity and AMPA/kainate receptor activation and trafficking, separating it from NMDA/LTP, nicotinic, vesicle-cycle and inhibitory synapse assembly confusables.

qualifier: destruction complex and TCF target transcription
name: Canonical Wnt signaling via destruction complex and beta-catenin/TCF
rationale: All members concern canonical Wnt/beta-catenin signaling centered on the AXIN/APC destruction complex and TCF/LEF target gene transcription, while confusables emphasize FZD/LRP receptor regulation, ligand secretion, antagonists or non-canonical Wnt.

qualifier: T cell cytokines and regulatory T cell differentiation
name: Suppression of T cell cytokines and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members inhibit IL-2, IL-21, IL-6 and TNF-family cytokine production and Treg differentiation while promoting activated T cell proliferation, unlike confusables centered on innate inflammatory signaling, IL-10/IL-12 or negative T cell responses.

qualifier: branching organs: kidney, lung, mammary, prostate
name: Branching epithelial organogenesis of kidney, lung, mammary gland and prostate
rationale: Members are epithelial-mesenchymal organogenesis of branching glandular and tubular organs (nephron and ureteric bud, lung, mammary, prostate, salivary, pancreas), which separates it from the heart, gonad/adrenal, glomerular podocyte and axial patterning confusables.

name: Chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy
rationale: All members concern chondroblast/chondrocyte condensation, proliferation, differentiation and growth plate hypertrophy, whereas every confusable centres on osteoblasts, ossification and tendon.
Members combine magnesium ion transport/homeostasis, inositol transport/metabolism and generic protein tetramerization/hexamerization, three strands with no shared biological process to name.

name: Intramembranous bone formation and tendon development
rationale: Members cover osteoblast development, direct ossification, cranial sutures, trabecular bone and tendon, distinguished from confusables that emphasize regulation of osteoblast differentiation/proliferation, collagen/proteoglycan synthesis or chondrocytes.

name: Cation-chloride cotransporters and sodium/proton exchangers
rationale: Members center on SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporters, SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers and potassium transport with their inherited disorders and vesicle acidification, unlike confusables built on SLC26/SLC4 anion exchange, renal sodium regulation or osmotic responses.

name: Mitotic centrosome maturation and AURKA/PLK1 activation
rationale: Members concern recruitment of mitotic centrosome proteins, centrosome separation and AURKA, PLK1 and NEK kinase activation at G2/M, distinguished from confusables on spindle checkpoint, cytokinesis, spindle orientation or centriole duplication.

name: Nuclear pore complex turnover and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members cover nuclear pore complex assembly, mitotic disassembly and reformation, and nucleocytoplasmic transport of inositol phosphates, which confusables on nuclear envelope, protein/RNA export or Rev transport lack.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: All members regulate cellular respiration, electron transport, oxidative phosphorylation and ATP/nucleotide synthesis (with ROS output), whereas confusables concern oxidative-stress responses, ferroptosis and peroxide-induced cell death.

qualifier: oocyte meiotic maturation and antral follicle growth
name: Oocyte meiotic maturation and antral follicle growth
rationale: Members concern regulation of oocyte meiotic maturation and antral-stage ovarian follicle growth, distinguishing it from germ cell migration/meiosis initiation, testis, and ovulation/luteinization confusables.

qualifier: sister chromatid cohesion, condensation and centromere assembly
name: Chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and spindle-driven mitotic segregation
rationale: Members span sister chromatid cohesion establishment and resolution, chromosome condensation, CENP-A centromere assembly, spindle/centrosome and checkpoint control, lacking the ESCRT nuclear envelope sealing, abscission and contractile ring content of the confusables.

core: Negative regulation of T cell responses
name: Suppression of effector T cell responses and Treg promotion
rationale: Members inhibit CD4/CD8 T cell activation, proliferation, Th1/Th17 commitment and IL-2/interferon production while promoting regulatory T cell differentiation, unlike confusables on NK cells, dendritic cell/costimulation tolerance or Th1/Treg transcriptional programs.

name: Sarcomeric myofilament assembly and muscle stretch sensing
rationale: Members are thin and thick (myosin) filament and myofibril assembly in skeletal and cardiac muscle plus stretch detection, distinguished from confusables on focal adhesion/cytoskeletal remodeling, heart morphogenesis and myoblast differentiation.

qualifier: outer membrane permeabilization under oxidative and hypoxic stress
name: Mitochondrial permeabilization control in oxidative and hypoxic apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization, cytochrome c release, membrane potential and BAD translocation in peroxide-, hypoxia- and ischemia-triggered intrinsic apoptosis, which confusables on calcium flux, extrinsic death receptors or nitrosative stress lack.

name: SLIT-ROBO midline repulsion of commissural axons
rationale: All members concern ROBO receptor signaling (RHOA, RAC1/CDC42, ABL, AKAP5) and the commissural midline choice it governs, distinguishing it from netrin/DCC, ephrin, L1 and region-specific axon guidance confusables.

qualifier: surveillance of snRNAs and cryptic unstable transcripts
name: Nuclear RNA surveillance and noncoding transcript decay
rationale: Members are nuclear RNA surveillance and degradation of snRNAs, cryptic unstable transcripts and aberrant mRNAs, unlike confusables on capping/splicing, mRNA export, rRNA/snoRNA processing or cytoplasmic mRNA decay.

name: Metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and negative regulation of kidney growth
rationale: Members cover metanephric mesenchymal-to-epithelial differentiation into nephron tubules plus restraint of kidney size, proliferation and developmental apoptosis, distinguished from ureteric bud/nephric duct and nephron segment patterning confusables.

qualifier: break sensing and NHEJ versus HR choice
name: DNA double-strand break sensing and NHEJ/HR repair choice
rationale: Members concern ATM-mediated sensing of double-strand breaks, classical and alternative end joining, regulation of homologous recombination and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects, whereas confusables emphasize end resection/Fanconi/PARP, telomere maintenance or replication stress.

qualifier: Dengue and RSV attachment and entry
name: Dengue and RSV attachment, entry and life cycle promotion
rationale: Members cover virus attachment, entry, transport and assembly for Dengue and RSV plus positive regulation of viral entry and life cycle, unlike confusables on host restriction, influenza/HIV endocytic entry or viral protein maturation.

name: Mitotic nuclear envelope breakdown, ESCRT-III resealing and abscission
rationale: Members cover lamina depolymerization, nuclear membrane disassembly and reassembly, ESCRT-III envelope sealing and midbody abscission, which the contractile-ring, nuclear pore/transport and chromosome cohesion confusables lack.
